entries.066fd8f626de1425: Yukan services for the deceased (bathing the body, applying makeup and preparing for the journey), and CDC services, which provide makeup, burial attire and encoffining. These services are provided by visiting the bereaved family's home or funeral hall in a specialized vehicle called a yukan vehicle.
entries.186a81173ffc2aac: Clean Services, which provide clearing of household goods and disposal of unwanted items before care begins, and house cleaning including pre-death clearing, estate clearing and memorial services for belongings, and Facility Referral Services, which support people needing care in finding a facility.
entries.1cf2e2690d4c8553: Elderly people receiving care and treatment at home
entries.1e4a55142b9f369d: A business centered on Angel Care Services, provided under contracts with wedding and funeral mutual-aid associations and funeral companies, and also providing Clean Services for pre-death and estate clearing, and facility referral services that support people in finding care facilities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,851 million.
entries.4a5aefaa0b209bb6: Rental and Sale of Welfare Equipment and Meal Delivery Services
entries.4bcd51dc14660bb9: Home-Based Care Support and Small-Scale Multifunctional Home Care Services
entries.78aab141af7e3480: A meal delivery service outside the long-term care insurance system, consisting of rental and sale of welfare equipment matched to users' physical conditions, and provision of meals considering health and nutrition, centered on day service centers.
entries.8341e0b07f8a205e: Clean Services and Facility Referral Services
entries.923dab083f0bbd6c: Home-based care support services, in which care managers prepare home service plans (care plans) and coordinate with service providers, and small-scale multifunctional home care services, which combine day attendance as the core with short-term overnight stays and home visits.
entries.9f8c07aee1a30cf5: Elderly people receiving care at home and their families
entries.a12c699b5fd5b81d: Elderly people requiring long-term care or support and their families
entries.ae8a41114ef82695: Home bathing services, in which specialized bathing vehicles visit the home to assist with bathing; home care services, in which care is provided at home for physical care and daily living assistance; and home nursing services, in which nurses and therapists visit to provide care for recuperation, assist with medical treatment and provide rehabilitation.
entries.c3c772f64b17acfe: Wedding and funeral mutual-aid associations and funeral companies
entries.d69581bb93d767c4: A nursing care services company that provides home care services such as day care and mobile bathing, and angel care services such as yukan (ritual body washing), mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area.
entries.dc86cbcc080e76f4: Elderly people receiving care at home
entries.de607f9da1168920: A service in which users travel to day service facilities by shuttle car and receive bathing and meal provision, consultation and advice on daily life, health status checks, daily living assistance and functional training. The company positions this day care service as the central business of its care business, and also operates composite care facilities that add other care services.
entries.fc5b710f86ea77aa: This business centers on day care services and provides home bathing, home care, home nursing, home-based care support, small-scale multifunctional home care, rental and sale of welfare equipment, and meal delivery services under the long-term care insurance system. Centered on the Tokyo metropolitan area, the company pursues dominant store openings, opening multiple facilities in areas where demand is expected. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,365 million.
